status: Reference specification only. Production double-angle solver and tests have not been implemented or executed.

sources.title: Steel Buildings in Europe - Multi-Storey Steel Buildings - Part 5 Joint Design
sources.authors: CTICM and SCI (Steel Alliance), European SECHALO project RFS2-CT-2008-0030
sources.factorPolicy: Eurocode recommended ordinary ULS factors. Tying uses a separately identified guidance gammaMu=1.1. Do not substitute SCI P358 UK plate gammaM2=1.1 into ordinary ULS.

ordinaryUlsPublishedCase.scope: Published beam/cleat/bolt components. Supporting-member dimensions and local resistance are absent, so this is not a complete support-inclusive node benchmark.

independentUnroundedCalculations.provenance: Independent arithmetic from stated geometry and guide equations, without production solver. Source-model betaLf=1 is reproduced only here; the implementation must resolve the long-joint qualification separately.

tolerances.rationale: The publication rounds alpha,beta and individual bearing capacities before group arithmetic; independent calculations retain precision. The 1% source tolerance does not apply to unrounded calculation tests.

missingForCompleteJointQualification: Supporting-member section, material, edge distances and bearing checks
Supporting-member local force transfer, relevant net/block and deformation mechanisms
Concomitant supporting-member actions or an explicit qualified local scope
NTC-specific policy and explicit SLS evidence for M20/22mm clearance

separatePublishedTyingCase.scope: Separate structural-integrity check, not an ordinary concomitant N+V check. This guidance is not an NTC-prescribed gammaMu.
separatePublishedTyingCase.productionStatus: Deferred until shared T-stub/prying and distinct accidental action policy exist. Do not copy gammaMu or fu-yielding substitution into ordinary ULS.

knownSourceIssues.issue: The final support-side comparison prints VEd=550kN while initial data, diagrams and summary give450kN. Preserve450kN as declared input; do not tune resistances to this typo.
One tying bearing comparison prints FEd=350kN while initial data and the other tying checks use370kN.
The guide uses0.8*ns*Fv,Rd for support-side shear-controlled groups. EN1993-1-8 3.7 alone does not contain this0.8 multiplier; identify it as guidance-model reduction.
The1.27 gross-shear denominator is a guidance correction for nominal bending, credited to Renkin2003. It is not a generic EN shear coefficient.

Lj=5*70=350mm exceeds15d. The example retains94kN per shear plane without an explicit3.8 exemption. Retain source output, flag qualification, and do not suppress a justified production reduction to match it.
T-stub m=(109-9-20-17.6)/2=31.2mm is rounded to31mm before further arithmetic. Preserve published and unrounded oracles as distinct data.
